adjudication.rationale: `Topic#expandable_first_post?` was changed from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb), i.e. the prior “no hosts configured => never expandable” gate was removed with no replacement check against the new `EmbeddableHost` table. The updated spec includes `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` but it no longer sets `embed_truncate` true or `has_topic_embed?` true, so it passes for unrelated default reasons and does not exercise the host-related behavior. Whether keeping expansion enabled for already-embedded topics after deleting all hosts is a product decision, but the diff-grounded issue (logic gate removal + non-covering test) is real.
